pr_title: Add a compatibility handler for StreamTexture2D -> CompressedTexture2D
pr_body:
While we don't have a compatibility guarantee across alpha releases, it makes sense to add a compatibility handler given how many people are using the 4.0 alphas already.

This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/59206. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/58788.
pr_comments: Nevermind, this was already added in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/58894.

issue_context.title: [Godot 4.0] Error when loading a resource in alpha4 (works well with alpha3)

### System information

### Minimal reproduction project

If necessary, I can prepare a minimal project with one scene that cause this issue.
comments: You need to delete the `.godot` directory (make sure the project is not opened when doing so). StreamTexture was renamed, so all imports are broken.
This will be fixed in 4.0alpha5 by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/58894.
I don't think so, that PR was included in alpha 4 AFAIR. A reimport is needed either way.
